S41.01.note: No setting makes new chats temporary by default; temporary is one on/off value, switched from the header control or Settings > Privacy > Chat privacy > Temporary Chat.
steps: Open the chat screen with no conversation selected.
Tap the eye-off icon at the top right of the header.
Read the alert "Turn on temporary chat?" and tap Turn on.
Look for the "Temporary" label with a purple background in the header; compare with Expected.
S41.01.where: Chat screen (new chat) > top-right "Temporary" control (eye-off icon) > "Turn on temporary chat?" > Turn on

S41.02.note: The banner is shown only once per app session (hasShownThisSession), not for as long as the chat is open; the persistent indicator is the header "Temporary" label, and the banner is rendered only on the chat thread screen, not the new chat screen.
steps: Turn on temporary chat from the header control on the new chat screen.
Send a message, then open that chat so the chat thread screen shows.
Look at the purple strip under the header with the explainer text.
Leave the chat and return to it; check whether the header "Temporary" label stays while the chat is open.
S41.02.where: Chat screen > top-right "Temporary" control > Turn on, then open a chat thread: the explainer banner appears under the header

labels.text: Won't appear in history or use memory, and is normally deleted after 30 days.

S41.03.needs: a Free or paid account; the cloud text appears in Cloud mode, the local text in Local mode
S41.03.note: Explanation text is fixed copy: cloud says it is normally deleted after 30 days, local says attachments never leave this device; the banner text is the same as the alert text.
steps: Tap the eye-off control on the new chat screen to open the "Turn on temporary chat?" alert.
Read the explanation text in the alert.
Turn on temporary chat, open a chat thread, and read the banner text.
Tap "Learn more" and check the Privacy screen that opens against the banner text.
S41.03.where: Chat screen > top-right "Temporary" control > read the alert text "Turn on temporary chat?"; in a chat thread, tap "Learn more" in the banner

S41.04.needs: a signed-in account in Cloud mode; a Free account may not show the switch
S41.04.note: The only temporary-chat choice found is the Personalized switch, which covers profile, instructions and style; memory is excluded in temporary chats by code (chatExecutionStore.ts:2798) with no separate choice, and the banner shows only once per app session.
steps: In Cloud mode, turn on temporary chat and open a chat thread so the banner shows.
Look at the line under the explainer: "Personalized" or "Unpersonalized" with a switch.
Switch it, then send a message in the temporary chat.
Compare the reply with Expected: the switch controls profile, instructions and response style, not memory.
S41.04.where: Chat thread with temporary chat on > banner under header > "Personalized" switch (Cloud mode only)

steps: Open Settings > Memory and note the count shown under the list.
Turn on temporary chat, send a message that states a personal fact, and wait for the reply.
Go back to Settings > Memory and compare the count with the one you noted.
Open "Memory summary" and check that the new fact is not listed.
S41.05.where: Effect seen in Settings > Memory > "Memory summary" (memory count does not grow after a temporary chat)

labels.text: Personalized uses your profile, instructions and response style. Unpersonalized leaves them out.

S41.06.needs: a signed-in account in Cloud mode and saved custom instructions
S41.06.note: The switch is hidden in Local mode, and the banner shows only once per app session, so reopen the app to see it again.
steps: In Cloud mode, turn on temporary chat and open a chat thread.
Set the banner switch to "Unpersonalized".
Ask a question that depends on your saved instructions or profile.
Compare the answer with Expected: it should ignore custom instructions while the switch is off.
S41.06.where: Chat thread with temporary chat on > banner under header > "Personalized" switch (Cloud mode only)

labels.text: Deleted and temporary chats are normally deleted for good after 30 days. A workspace legal hold can keep them longer.

S41.08.needs: a file to upload; a Free or paid account
S41.08.note: The Local-mode banner says attachments never leave the device, but no file-specific retention text was found for Cloud mode; only the chat 30-day note exists.
steps: Turn on temporary chat, open a chat thread and read the banner text.
Go to Settings > Privacy > Chat privacy.
Read the footnote under the group with "Shared links" and "Archived chats" (Cloud mode) and "Delete all chats".
Attach a file in a temporary chat and compare what the app says about how long it is kept with Expected.
S41.08.where: Settings > Privacy > Chat privacy (footnote under the retention group); temporary-chat banner in a chat thread

labels.text: Local chats stay on this device unless you sync them.

S41.14.needs: none for Local mode; a signed-in account to compare with Cloud
S41.14.note: Whether a Local chat is uploaded to the account can only be confirmed indirectly; no on-screen proof was found.
steps: Open the side menu from the top left of the chat screen, or open Settings.
Tap the "Local" segment of the Local / Cloud control.
Start a new chat, send a message, and check that it is kept on this device.
Open Settings > Privacy and read "Local chats stay on this device unless you sync them." and compare with Expected.
S41.14.where: Side menu (drawer) or Settings > top segmented control "Local" / "Cloud" > choose Local

S41.16.note: No separate local-only memory switch was found; the device-only scope follows the Local mode toggle.
steps: Switch to Local mode with the Local / Cloud control.
Open Settings > Memory.
Read the scope line under the list; expect "Stored on this device only."
Open "Memory summary" and read the info card: "On-device memory".
S41.16.where: Settings > Memory > Local segment (Local / Cloud) > Memory summary, which says "Stored on this device only."

S41.17.needs: a throwaway install or test account; this is destructive
S41.17.note: "Clear cache" only removes temporary files; the full wipe is under Danger Zone.
steps: Open Settings > Storage and scroll to the bottom.
Tap "Delete everything" under "Danger Zone".
Read the alert "Delete all local data?", then tap "Delete Everything" and read the second alert.
Compare the result with Expected: the app should wipe local data, sign out and return to onboarding.
S41.17.where: Settings > Storage > scroll to "Danger Zone" > "Delete everything"

S41.18.needs: a signed-in account in Cloud mode for the training controls; "Data retention" card only in Cloud mode
steps: Open Settings > Privacy and read the three cards under "Our approach to privacy".
Open Settings > Privacy > Chat privacy and see "Temporary Chat" as its own switch.
Back on Settings > Privacy, scroll to "AGI Cloud privacy controls" in Cloud mode.
Check that training choices ("Use my chats", "Use my voice") are listed apart from history and retention, and compare with Expected.
S41.18.where: Settings > Privacy: "Model training", "Telemetry off by default", "Data retention" card; "Chat privacy" > "Temporary Chat" and "Delete all chats"

labels.text: Personalized uses your profile, instructions and response style. Unpersonalized leaves them out.

S41.19.needs: none for the Privacy cards; a signed-in Cloud account for the personalization switch
S41.19.note: Explanations are fixed text per row; the explainer for a switch shows as a hint, not as a visible line, in the banner.
steps: Open Settings > Privacy and read the body text under "Model training", "Telemetry off by default" and "Data retention".
Open Settings > Privacy > Chat privacy and read the footnote under "Temporary Chat".
Turn on temporary chat, open a chat thread and read the "Personalized" hint.
Compare each explanation with what the switch or setting does, against Expected.
S41.19.where: Settings > Privacy: each card under "Our approach to privacy" has its own explanation line; "Chat privacy" > "Temporary Chat" footnote

labels.text: Where each feature processes your data

S41.20.note: Rows marked iOS-only appear only on iPhone, so a Mac-simulated test may show fewer rows.
steps: Open Settings > Privacy and tap "Data use & access".
Scroll to "Where each feature processes your data".
Read each feature row, starting with "Chat in Local Mode" and "Chat in AGI Cloud".
Compare the listed place (on this device, AGI Cloud, or the named provider) with Expected.
S41.20.where: Settings > Privacy > "Data use & access" > scroll to "Where each feature processes your data"
